sentences.zh: 我父亲是在内布拉斯加州一个非常共和党的地区当选的县检察官。

sentences.zh: 我记得1980年他开车带我去投票站。

sentences.zh: 他声称有权终止出生公民权，尽管这在第十四修正案中是有保障的。

sentences.en: Since Doge has started, it's firing thousands of federal workers, there's a lot going on.
sentences.zh: 自从“狗狗币部门”（Doge）成立以来，它已经解雇了数千名联邦雇员，现在发生了很多事情。

sentences.en: So with that in mind, do you have any idea just how raucous these town halls are going to get?
sentences.zh: 考虑到这一点，你有没有想过这些市政厅会议会变得多么喧闹？

sentences.en: Going into that first one?
sentences.zh: 在参加第一场会议时？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Here's the deal.
sentences.zh: 情况是这样的。

sentences.en: That $36 trillion number is not going away.
sentences.zh: 那36万亿美元的数字不会消失。

sentences.en: It is not going away unless we deal with Medicare and Medicaid.
sentences.zh: 除非我们处理好联邦医疗保险（Medicare）和医疗补助（Medicaid），否则它不会消失。

sentences.en: Let's remain calm.
sentences.zh: 让我们保持冷静。

sentences.en: It was in Columbus, a town my wife was born in, raised in, a town 45 minutes south of me.
sentences.zh: 那是在哥伦布市，我妻子出生和长大的地方，一个离我45分钟车程的城镇。

sentences.en: And this is something we have to do as a country.
sentences.zh: 这是我们作为一个国家必须要做的事情。

sentences.en: I couldn't have predicted that it would have gone like that.
sentences.zh: 我无法预料事情会变成那样。

sentences.en: A balanced budget where we...
sentences.zh: 一个平衡的预算，我们……

sentences.en: How can you be against a balanced budget?
sentences.zh: 你怎么能反对平衡预算呢？

sentences.en: How can you be against a balanced budget?
sentences.zh: 你怎么能反对平衡预算呢？

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Elon Musk gets $40 billion a year in funding from the federal government.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克每年从联邦政府获得400亿美元的资金。

sentences.en: Do you think he would cut that before he would cut our Medicare or our Social Security or our jobs?
sentences.zh: 你认为他在削减我们的联邦医疗保险、社会保障或我们的工作岗位之前，会先削减那笔资金吗？

sentences.en: I support Elon Musk and the Department of Government Efficiency.
sentences.zh: 我支持埃隆·马斯克和政府效率部。

sentences.en: And I think when it was over, I was stunned and a little numb.
sentences.zh: 我想当一切结束时，我感到震惊，甚至有点麻木。

sentences.en: That's my honest, that's honestly how I felt.
sentences.zh: 这是我的真心话，我确实是这么感觉的。

sentences.en: I don't think your high school civics teacher would endorse that behavior.
sentences.zh: 我不认为你的高中公民课老师会赞同那种行为。

sentences.en: And on the drive back to Norfolk, which is 45 minutes, I was just replaying in my head everything that I saw and I heard.
sentences.zh: 在开车回诺福克的路上，那要45分钟，我脑子里一直在回放我所看到和听到的一切。

sentences.en: What are you doing to be real with people about how Trump is breaking the law?
sentences.zh: 你做了什么来向人们坦诚特朗普是如何违法的？

sentences.en: And I got home and...
sentences.zh: 我回到家，然后……

sentences.en: When are you and Congress going to take back your responsibility?
sentences.zh: 你和国会打算什么时候承担起你们的责任？

sentences.en: I just had to kind of just process everything.
sentences.zh: 我只是需要消化这一切。

sentences.en: You have done nothing.
sentences.zh: 你们什么都没做。

sentences.en: Who's lying?
sentences.zh: 谁在撒谎？

sentences.en: Them or you?
sentences.zh: 是他们还是你？

sentences.en: Why are you doing this to your constituents?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要这样对待你的选民？

sentences.en: When are you going to do something?
sentences.zh: 你们打算什么时候采取行动？

sentences.en: This is where we're at.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们现在的处境。

sentences.en: You have an oath.
sentences.zh: 你们有誓言在身。

sentences.en: We need actual action.
sentences.zh: 我们需要实际的行动。

sentences.en: When are you going to stand up?
sentences.zh: 你们打算什么时候站出来？

sentences.en: It's interesting because it felt like the subtext of a lot of the questions you were getting in these town halls, especially early on, is where is Congress right now?
sentences.zh: 很有意思，因为在这些市政厅会议上，你收到的很多问题的潜台词，尤其是在早期，似乎都在问：国会现在在哪里？

sentences.en: Where in particular are congressional Republicans as a check on a president who is exercising a greater level of power than any president in modern history?
sentences.zh: 特别是国会共和党人，作为对一位行使着现代史上前所未有权力的总统的制衡，你们在哪里？

sentences.en: And there's one inquiry that stood out to me.
sentences.zh: 有一个提问让我印象深刻。

sentences.en: Yeah, my question is regarding your oath of office.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的问题是关于你的就职誓言。

sentences.en: So you have, up until now, abdicated all of your rights as Congress to the executive branch.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，你们已经将国会的所有权利让渡给了行政部门。

sentences.en: And if you don't act as a check and a balance...
sentences.zh: 如果你们不履行制衡的职责……

sentences.en: The question ended with this voter saying...
sentences.zh: 那位选民的问题最后是这样说的……

sentences.en: What exactly is the purpose of Congress?
sentences.zh: 国会到底有什么用？

sentences.en: Why do you even exist?
sentences.zh: 你们为什么还要存在？

sentences.en: I have not abdicated any responsibility I have under the Constitution of the United States.
sentences.zh: 我没有放弃任何美国宪法赋予我的责任。

sentences.en: Well, I think some of that is overblown, and let me tell you why.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为有些说法言过其实了，让我告诉你为什么。

sentences.en: There's this idea that if you are providing oversight or the checks and balances, that it has to be done on CNN at 9 o'clock Eastern or Fox News at 9 o'clock Eastern.
sentences.zh: 有一种观点认为，如果你要进行监督或制衡，就必须在东部时间9点的CNN或福克斯新闻上进行。

sentences.en: If I'm going to draw a red line, I'm not going to draw it on TV.
sentences.zh: 如果我要划定红线，我不会在电视上划。

sentences.en: I'm going to draw it with the people that are actually in charge of their part of the government.
sentences.zh: 我会与那些实际负责政府相关部门的人进行沟通。

sentences.en: You're saying it's unseen.
sentences.zh: 你是说这是不公开的。

sentences.en: Well, it's unseen by the people that are dealing with the issue.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对于处理这些问题的人来说，这不是不公开的。

sentences.en: It's just not done for public purposes.
sentences.zh: 只是没有为了公开展示而做。

sentences.en: When I see things that I do not think are right, I work on them, I speak out against them, and I stand up.
sentences.zh: 当我看到我认为不对的事情时，我会去处理，我会公开反对，我会站出来。

sentences.en: I also, and I'm going to say this loud and clear, I voted for Donald Trump, and I support Donald Trump as president.
sentences.zh: 我也要大声且明确地说，我投票给了唐纳德·特朗普，我支持唐纳德·特朗普担任总统。

sentences.en: He's done more to address the root issues of this country in the last four months than we saw from our prior president.
sentences.zh: 在过去四个月里，他为解决这个国家的根本问题所做的工作，比我们从前任总统那里看到的要多。

sentences.en: And I believe that, and I want to say that out loud so that I'm on record doing that.
sentences.zh: 我相信这一点，我想大声说出来，这样我就有据可查了。

sentences.en: Well, you did say that in your answer to this constituent, that you do speak out when you don't like something.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你在回答那位选民时确实说过，当你对某事不满时，你会公开表达。

sentences.en: But let's get specific.
sentences.zh: 但让我们具体一点。

sentences.en: Have you spoken out against anything Trump has done in his second term specifically?
sentences.zh: 在特朗普的第二个任期内，你是否明确反对过他做的任何事情？

sentences.en: The National Weather Service cuts.
sentences.zh: 国家气象局的削减预算。

sentences.en: National Weather Service is a vital federal agency for Nebraska because we are in Tornado Alley.
sentences.zh: 国家气象局对内布拉斯加州来说是一个至关重要的联邦机构，因为我们处于龙卷风走廊。

sentences.en: You know, I'm visiting these offices, and they're down 40%.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我走访了这些办公室，他们的人员减少了40%。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And this was a hill to die on for me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这是必须坚守的底线。

sentences.en: Like, this was public safety.
sentences.zh: 这关乎公共安全。

sentences.en: And so, you know, I was successfully able to get this going.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我成功地解决了这个问题。

sentences.en: And since they've hired back people, so that would be one example.
sentences.zh: 他们已经重新雇佣了人员，这就是一个例子。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Why did you not say that at the town hall when you're speaking to voters?
sentences.zh: 为什么你在市政厅会议上对选民讲话时没有提到这一点？

sentences.en: Did it occur to you to say that?
sentences.zh: 你有没有想过要说出来？

sentences.en: Look, I pushed back.
sentences.zh: 听着，我进行了反击。

sentences.en: I got these jobs restored at the National Weather Service.
sentences.zh: 我恢复了国家气象局的这些工作岗位。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I did at one of them.
sentences.zh: 我在其中一场会议上提到了。

sentences.en: But, you know, like, who wants to work with a grandstander?
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，谁想和一个爱出风头的人共事呢？

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你明白我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Like, the goal is to fix the problem.
sentences.zh: 目标是解决问题。

sentences.en: And I'm happy as hell that it got fixed.
sentences.zh: 我非常高兴问题得到了解决。

sentences.en: Well, grandstanding is an interesting word for what speaking out against something you don't like is.
sentences.zh: 嗯，“爱出风头”这个词用来形容反对你不喜欢的事情，这很有意思。

sentences.en: And I think you may know where I'm headed here.
sentences.zh: 我想你可能知道我要说什么了。

sentences.en: In the second Trump presidency, it feels like lawmakers, especially with the Republican Party, are fearful of publicly getting crosswise with the president.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普的第二个总统任期内，感觉立法者，尤其是共和党人，害怕公开与总统意见相左。

sentences.en: And when you were asked about abdicating your role, when you were asked about specific policies,
sentences.zh: 当你被问及放弃职责时，当你被问及具体政策时，

sentences.en: you, in these town halls, tend to specifically go out of your way to emphasize how much regard you have for the president.
sentences.zh: 在这些市政厅会议上，你往往会特意强调你对总统有多么尊重。

sentences.en: And you say, I want to make that loud and clear.
sentences.zh: 你说，我想大声且明确地表达这一点。

sentences.en: I voted for him.
sentences.zh: 我投票给了他。

sentences.en: I mean, am I right to intuit a certain level of, I don't want to step in it in this town hall, and I don't want to become the subject of the president's ire?
sentences.zh: 我是不是可以直觉地认为，你是不想在市政厅会议上惹麻烦，也不想成为总统愤怒的对象？

sentences.en: Does that constrain you in this environment?
sentences.zh: 这种环境是否限制了你？

sentences.en: It sounds like it does.
sentences.zh: 听起来确实如此。

sentences.en: I am supportive of the president.
sentences.zh: 我支持总统。

sentences.en: I mean, when I got to Congress in 2022, 65% of my time was dealing with agency rules and regulations
sentences.zh: 我是说，当我2022年进入国会时，我65%的时间都在处理机构的规则和条例，

sentences.en: that were punishing all sorts of folks in Nebraska, whether it be farmers, ranchers, banks, you name it.
sentences.zh: 这些规则惩罚了内布拉斯加州的各种人，无论是农民、牧场主、银行，等等。

sentences.en: And the relief that came on January 20th is what I voted for.
sentences.zh: 而1月20日带来的解脱正是我投票支持的。

sentences.en: Like, that's what I wanted.
sentences.zh: 我想要的就是这个。

sentences.en: I wanted innovation.
sentences.zh: 我想要创新。

sentences.en: I want all of these new ideas.
sentences.zh: 我想要所有这些新想法。

sentences.en: Do President Trump and I have the same demeanor?
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统和我的风度一样吗？

sentences.en: Probably not.
sentences.zh: 可能不一样。

sentences.en: I think it's fair to say that we don't.
sentences.zh: 我认为公平地说，我们不一样。

sentences.en: But I thought it was very important that I say, listen, I support President Trump,
sentences.zh: 但我认为非常重要的一点是，我要说，听着，我支持特朗普总统，

sentences.en: and I support Elon Musk in doing what they're doing because the federal debt is a big issue for me, and the spending is a big issue for me.
sentences.zh: 我也支持埃隆·马斯克所做的事情，因为联邦债务对我来说是一个大问题，支出也是一个大问题。

sentences.en: And although the way it was approached at all times wouldn't be my preference, I think that the overall arc of what we're doing in terms of spending is important.
sentences.zh: 虽然处理方式并不总是我的首选，但我认为我们在支出方面所做的整体方向是很重要的。

sentences.en: What I heard were some people in that room saying, where are you pushing back at all?
sentences.zh: 我听到房间里有些人问，你到底在哪里进行了反击？

sentences.en: And I think essentially what they're asking, and I'd ask it on their behalf is, is there anything besides the National Weather Service, for example,
sentences.zh: 我想他们本质上是在问，我也代表他们问一下，除了国家气象局之外，

sentences.en: that the president has done that has concerned you?
sentences.zh: 总统做的还有什么事情让你感到担忧吗？

sentences.en: Well, tariffs concern me because it introduces uncertainty into our economy.
sentences.zh: 嗯，关税让我担心，因为它给我们的经济带来了不确定性。

sentences.en: But you look at the first time he ran, he made it work.
sentences.zh: 但你看看他第一次竞选时，他成功了。

sentences.en: So we're counting on that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们指望这一点。

sentences.en: I mean…
sentences.zh: 我是说……

sentences.en: So there's something.
sentences.zh: 所以还是有问题的。

sentences.en: Just to put it really plainly, do you feel like you can be truly candid in any disapproval that you have of President Trump's actions,
sentences.zh: 说得直白一点，你是否觉得在对特朗普总统的行为有任何不满时，你能真正坦诚地表达出来，

sentences.en: especially in a public room where cameras may be rolling, people are searching for viral moments?
sentences.zh: 特别是在可能有摄像机拍摄、人们在寻找病毒式传播时刻的公共场合？

sentences.en: I understand that if you pop over the hedge and say, nope, I don't agree with that, right?
sentences.zh: 我明白，如果你跳出来说，不，我不同意，对吧？

sentences.en: For me to do that, I have to be convicted in what I'm doing.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，要这样做，我必须对我所做的事情有坚定的信念。

sentences.en: I want to know where my conference is at.
sentences.zh: 我想知道我的党团会议立场在哪里。

sentences.en: You don't come over the hill with no one.
sentences.zh: 你不能孤军奋战。

sentences.en: And sometimes he just says things, right?
sentences.zh: 有时他只是随口说说，对吧？

sentences.en: Like seizing the Panama Canal, turning Alcatraz into a prison again.
sentences.zh: 比如夺取巴拿马运河，把恶魔岛重新变成监狱。

sentences.en: You know, like don't take the bait.
sentences.zh: 你知道，别上钩。

sentences.en: Like look at what you're trying to accomplish.
sentences.zh: 看看你想要实现什么目标。

sentences.en: Like I'm trying to get housing reform going.
sentences.zh: 比如我正在努力推动住房改革。

sentences.en: I go to work every single day and I work on that bill, and I'm talking to people about that bill, and it's bipartisan.
sentences.zh: 我每天都去工作，致力于那个法案，我和人们谈论那个法案，它是两党合作的。

sentences.en: And so I know that it would make some people on the left love every minute of seeing their member up over the hedge every single day.
sentences.zh: 我知道，看到他们的议员每天都跳出来反对，会让左派的一些人感到非常过瘾。

sentences.en: But you don't get to have a new red line every day just because a subset of your constituents are livid about X.
sentences.zh: 但你不能仅仅因为你的一部分选民对某事感到愤怒，就每天都划定一条新的红线。

sentences.en: He is the leader of the party that I'm in.
sentences.zh: 他是我们党派的领袖。

sentences.en: And there's a balance.
sentences.zh: 这需要平衡。

sentences.en: I will continue to do town halls.
sentences.zh: 我会继续举行市政厅会议。

sentences.en: I will continue to show up in person.
sentences.zh: 我会继续亲自出席。

sentences.en: And I want to thank all of you for coming.
sentences.zh: 我想感谢大家的到来。

sentences.en: Good night.
sentences.zh: 晚安。

sentences.en: Okay, when you exit, please go out the exit right here on your left.
sentences.zh: 好的，离开时，请从左侧的出口离开。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Here's what I ask of you tonight.
sentences.zh: 这是我今晚对你们的要求。

sentences.en: I know some of you are angry.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们有些人很生气。

sentences.en: I know some of you are upset.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们有些人很沮丧。

sentences.en: Let's make this a model for the nation in how we can have a discussion about the future of America,
sentences.zh: 让我们把这次会议作为一个典范，展示我们如何能够就美国的未来进行讨论，

sentences.en: and we can talk as much about ideas and solutions as we do identifying the probleMs.
sentences.zh: 我们可以像讨论问题一样，多讨论一些想法和解决方案。

sentences.en: Because ultimately, it's my job to do the best job I can representing all of you.
sentences.zh: 因为归根结底，我的工作就是尽我所能代表你们所有人。

sentences.en: With that, I want to cut my remarks short.
sentences.zh: 说到这里，我想缩短我的发言。

sentences.en: I want to get right into questions and answers.
sentences.zh: 我想直接进入问答环节。

sentences.en: Let me get back to this idea of Congress's responsibility, your responsibility.
sentences.zh: 让我回到国会的责任，也就是你们的责任这个话题上。

sentences.en: Hello, Congressman Flatt.
sentences.zh: 你好，弗拉特议员。

sentences.en: I share your concern for our national debt, but the M's do not justify the means.
sentences.zh: 我认同你对国债的担忧，但目的不能证明手段的正当性。

sentences.en: You had an exchange with someone at a town hall who asked you about a provision of the president's giant domestic policy bill,
sentences.zh: 你在市政厅会议上与某人有过交流，他问你关于总统庞大的国内政策法案中的一项条款，

sentences.en: one big, beautiful bill, as he refers to it, that would have seriously curtailed the power of the federal courts.
sentences.zh: 正如他所说的“一个伟大、美丽的法案”，该法案将严重削弱联邦法院的权力。

sentences.en: Can you please tell us why you voted to approve a budget bill that includes Section 70302, which effectively prohibits federal courts from enforcing contempt orders?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们为什么你投票批准了一项包含第70302条的预算案，该条款实际上禁止联邦法院执行藐视法庭的命令吗？

sentences.en: And contempt orders allow federal judges to hold the executive branch accountable when they defy the courts.
sentences.zh: 藐视法庭令能让联邦法官在行政部门违抗法院时追究其责任。

sentences.en: It's really their only tool.
sentences.zh: 这确实是他们唯一的工具。

sentences.en: Which would then allow current and future administrations to ignore those contempt orders by removing the enforcement capabilities.
sentences.zh: 这会让现任及未来的政府通过剥夺执法能力，从而无视这些藐视法庭令。

sentences.en: I do not agree with that section that was added to that bill.
sentences.zh: 我不同意法案中增加的那一部分。

sentences.en: This provision was unknown to me when I voted for the bill.
sentences.zh: 我在投票支持该法案时，并不知晓这一条款。

sentences.en: Okay, next question.
sentences.zh: 好的，下一个问题。

sentences.en: Next question.
sentences.zh: 下一个问题。

sentences.en: I am not going to hide the truth.
sentences.zh: 我不会隐瞒真相。

sentences.en: This provision was unknown to me when I voted for that bill.
sentences.zh: 我在投票支持该法案时，并不知晓这一条款。

sentences.en: And what you told this voter, congressman, is that you didn't know that provision was in the bill, presumably because you didn't read the entire bill before you voted for it.
sentences.zh: 国会议员，你告诉这位选民的是，你不知道法案里有这一条款，大概是因为你在投票前没有通读整个法案。

sentences.en: So how did it feel having to kind of admit that, which you did, that you voted for something you didn't quite understand?
sentences.zh: 那么，不得不承认这一点——你确实承认了——即你投票支持了自己并不完全理解的东西，感觉如何？

sentences.en: Two things here.
sentences.zh: 这里有两点。

sentences.en: I did read the bill.
sentences.zh: 我读了法案。

sentences.en: I voted for that one big, beautiful bill.
sentences.zh: 我投票支持了那个宏大、美好的法案。

sentences.en: Well, I voted until like 7 in the morning.
sentences.zh: 我一直投票到凌晨7点左右。

sentences.en: I got on a plane.
sentences.zh: 我上了飞机。

sentences.en: I went back home to Nebraska.
sentences.zh: 我回到了内布拉斯加州的家中。

sentences.en: Now it's 9.30 at night.
sentences.zh: 现在是晚上9点半。

sentences.en: Someone in the legal community in Nebraska calls me.
sentences.zh: 内布拉斯加州法律界的一位人士给我打电话。

sentences.en: And like, did you know this is in the bill?
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道法案里有这个吗？

sentences.en: I was like, what are you talking about?
sentences.zh: 我说，你在说什么？

sentences.en: Well, this section.
sentences.zh: 就是这一节。

sentences.en: So I pull it up.
sentences.zh: 于是我把它调出来看。

sentences.en: I went to law school.
sentences.zh: 我读过法学院。

sentences.en: I practiced as a general practitioner for 20 years.
sentences.zh: 我做了20年的全科律师。

sentences.en: You can read those seven lines 15 times.
sentences.zh: 你可以把那七行字读上15遍。

sentences.en: And if you aren't a practitioner in a federal district court on issues like constitutional issues, like I've never been to federal district court.
sentences.zh: 但如果你不是在联邦地区法院处理宪法等问题的执业律师——我从未去过联邦地区法院。

sentences.en: And the way that provision was written, I had to go to an article written by a Notre Dame law professor to really understand its import.
sentences.zh: 按照那个条款的写法，我必须去查阅一位圣母大学法学教授写的文章，才能真正理解它的含义。

sentences.en: And after I did those things, I felt terrible.
sentences.zh: 做完这些之后，我感觉糟透了。

sentences.en: I didn't want that in there.
sentences.zh: 我不希望它出现在里面。

sentences.en: I didn't have any interest in defanging the federal district courts.
sentences.zh: 我根本没兴趣削弱联邦地区法院的权力。

sentences.en: And that was a red line for me.
sentences.zh: 那对我来说是一条红线。

sentences.en: And honestly, I appreciated the question.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我很感激那个问题。

sentences.en: The only way through that was to be honest and to tell them how much that meant.
sentences.zh: 解决这个问题的唯一方法就是诚实，告诉他们这对我意味着什么。

sentences.en: I wasn't going to hide it.
sentences.zh: 我不会隐瞒它。

sentences.en: I couldn't defend it.
sentences.zh: 我无法为它辩护。

sentences.en: There was no way around it.
sentences.zh: 这根本没法绕过去。

sentences.en: Hey, why are you guys booing me?
sentences.zh: 嘿，你们为什么要嘘我？

sentences.en: I'm just telling you I didn't do the bare minimum of my job.
sentences.zh: 我只是告诉你们，我没能完成工作的最低限度。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That moment went basically viral and not necessarily in a good way.
sentences.zh: 那一刻基本上在网上疯传了，而且未必是以一种好的方式。

sentences.en: It is never a good sign in your defense to that in front of your own constituents was, I didn't read that version.
sentences.zh: 在选民面前为自己辩护时，说出“我没读过那个版本”从来都不是什么好兆头。

sentences.en: Listen, I don't know what would be worse, honestly, if he was really this negligent or if he voted for it because he thinks Trump should be a king, like Hinson does, apparently.
sentences.zh: 听着，老实说，我不知道哪种情况更糟：是他真的如此疏忽，还是他投票支持是因为他认为特朗普应该像个国王一样，就像欣森显然认为的那样。

sentences.en: It's not like a 23andMe terms of service agreement where you can just blindly sign it.
sentences.zh: 这又不是那种你可以盲目签署的“23andMe”服务条款协议。

sentences.en: And now there's a clone of you who's a sex slave for an Uzbek oligarch.
sentences.zh: 结果冒出一个克隆体，成了乌兹别克寡头的性奴。

sentences.en: Unlike that, these bills are important.
sentences.zh: 与此不同，这些法案很重要。

sentences.en: You know, my oldest son, Brennan, said, Dad, you didn't read the bill.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我大儿子布伦南说，爸爸，你没读法案。

sentences.en: Well, I said, I missed it, Brennan.
sentences.zh: 我说，我错过了，布伦南。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I missed it.
sentences.zh: 我错过了。

sentences.en: He must have seen this moment as well somewhere on the Internet.
sentences.zh: 他一定也在网上的某个地方看到了这一幕。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: And, you know, he got ridiculed for that, I'm sure.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他肯定因此被嘲笑了。

sentences.en: So to say it bothered me, it really bothered me.
sentences.zh: 所以说这困扰着我，它确实困扰着我。

sentences.en: The next day after I figured that out, I called my staff.
sentences.zh: 弄清楚这件事的第二天，我召集了我的幕僚。

sentences.en: We got a hell of the Senate Judiciary Committee.
sentences.zh: 我们联系了参议院司法委员会。

sentences.en: We flagged it for them.
sentences.zh: 我们为他们标记了出来。

sentences.en: And the reason we have three rounds in our unicameral is that things get in bills that you end up figuring out what their real import is.
sentences.zh: 我们在单院制议会中进行三轮投票的原因是，法案中总会混入一些内容，你最终才会发现它们的真实含义。

sentences.en: You take them out.
sentences.zh: 你把它们剔除掉。

sentences.en: This is part of the process of lawmaking.
sentences.zh: 这是立法过程的一部分。

sentences.en: What I voted for was not a law.
sentences.zh: 我投票支持的并不是一项法律。

sentences.en: I voted for a bill that went to the Senate, and that was stripped out, and I was able to vote for it.
sentences.zh: 我投票支持的是一份提交给参议院的法案，那部分被删除了，我才得以投票支持它。

sentences.en: So it worked.
sentences.zh: 所以它奏效了。

sentences.en: The process worked.
sentences.zh: 程序奏效了。

sentences.en: But I guess I'm just – does a moment like this help explain to you why some of the people in these town halls were so upset?
sentences.zh: 但我猜我只是——像这样的时刻能帮你解释为什么市政厅会议上的一些人会如此愤怒吗？

sentences.en: Could you understand where they were coming from?
sentences.zh: 你能理解他们的立场吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 能。

sentences.en: We've got people to come to these town halls that are upset to start with.
sentences.zh: 来参加这些市政厅会议的人本来就是带着怨气的。

sentences.en: I mean they are receiving all of their news and information oftentimes from a television network that has a slant just like Republicans are receiving their news and information from a network that has a slant.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们获取新闻和信息往往来自一个有偏见的电视网络，就像共和党人从一个有偏见的网络获取新闻和信息一样。

sentences.en: And there's not a lot of nonpartisan information that comes.
sentences.zh: 而且并没有多少中立的信息来源。

sentences.en: So they come angry to start with.
sentences.zh: 所以他们一开始就带着怒气而来。

sentences.en: Well, and then they hear their congressman, as earnest as you are, saying,
sentences.zh: 嗯，然后他们听到他们的国会议员，尽管你很诚恳，却说：

sentences.en: I didn't know that I was voting for a bill that was going to neuter the courts at a moment where the president is already defying them.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我投票支持的法案会在总统已经藐视法院的时候削弱法院的权力。

sentences.en: Yeah, I get it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我明白。

sentences.en: I get it.
sentences.zh: 我明白。

sentences.en: The only way through that, though, is to tell them the truth.
sentences.zh: 不过，解决这个问题的唯一方法就是告诉他们真相。

sentences.en: And you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: I slept better that night than I had in a long time because I didn't blink.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上我睡得比很长一段时间以来都要好，因为我没有退缩。

sentences.en: And as mad as people are and as much as people can get upset about that, isn't that kind of what they also want?
sentences.zh: 尽管人们很生气，尽管人们会因此感到不安，但这不正是他们想要的吗？

sentences.en: They want you to stand up.
sentences.zh: 他们希望你站出来。

sentences.en: They want you to be there.
sentences.zh: 他们希望你在场。

sentences.en: One thing I'd add here, that exchange right there is the reason why politicians on both sides of the aisle don't want to do town halls.
sentences.zh: 我还要补充一点，刚才那段交流正是两党政客都不想举行市政厅会议的原因。

sentences.en: Because these things are real, they're raw, and they are as accountable as anything else in America.
sentences.zh: 因为这些事情是真实的、赤裸裸的，而且它们和美国任何其他事物一样需要承担责任。

sentences.en: Well, good evening, Lincoln.
sentences.zh: 好吧，晚上好，林肯市。

sentences.en: Thank you very much for being here tonight.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家今晚来到这里。

sentences.en: I know that many of you stood in line for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们很多人排了很长时间的队。

sentences.en: I know that many of you have made this a point to be here.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们很多人特意赶来这里。

sentences.en: And here's the deal.
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的。

sentences.en: So, Congressman, in your final town hall this year, which you held after this bill, the one big, beautiful bill, as it was known, officially passes.
sentences.zh: 那么，国会议员，在你今年最后一次市政厅会议上，也就是在那份被称为“宏大、美好法案”的法案正式通过之后举行的会议上。

sentences.en: I want to go right into this bill because I know this is something a lot of people have questions about.
sentences.zh: 我想直接谈谈这个法案，因为我知道很多人对此有疑问。

sentences.en: Okay, let's start here.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们从这里开始。

sentences.en: That's when voter anger seems to reach a fever pitch.
sentences.zh: 那时选民的愤怒似乎达到了顶点。

sentences.en: First of all, I'd ask you, please, not to refer to that monstrosity as the big, beautiful bill.
sentences.zh: 首先，我请求你不要把那个怪物称为“宏大、美好的法案”。

sentences.en: It's the name of the bill, though.
sentences.zh: 但这确实是法案的名字。

sentences.en: So how can you justify taking health care away from 78,000 Nebraskans?
sentences.zh: 那么你如何证明剥夺7.8万名内布拉斯加人的医疗保健是正当的？

sentences.en: As I explained before, this bill protects Medicaid for the future.
sentences.zh: 正如我之前解释的那样，该法案保护了未来的医疗补助计划。

sentences.en: People are asking you about cuts to Medicaid.
sentences.zh: 人们在问你关于削减医疗补助的问题。

sentences.en: Why did you cut SNAP and health care research?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要削减补充营养援助计划（SNAP）和医疗研究经费？

sentences.en: We do not have unlimited money in the United States.
sentences.zh: 美国的资金并非无限。

sentences.en: It's a food stamp.
sentences.zh: 那是食品券。

sentences.en: SNAP.
sentences.zh: SNAP。

sentences.en: And I see this new bill that transfers trillions of dollars of wealth from working-class Americans, people that are sitting in this room,
sentences.zh: 我看到这个新法案将数万亿美元的财富从工薪阶层的美国人——也就是坐在房间里的这些人——手中转移出去，

sentences.en: to billionaires that don't even live in this state.
sentences.zh: 转移给那些甚至不住在这个州的亿万富翁。

sentences.en: And so my question is, I know who I work for, but who do you work for?
sentences.zh: 所以我的问题是，我知道我为谁工作，但你为谁工作？

sentences.en: So my question is, did you read the bill?
sentences.zh: 所以我的问题是，你读过法案吗？

sentences.en: I read the bill.
sentences.zh: 我读了法案。

sentences.en: I read the bills.
sentences.zh: 我读了这些法案。

sentences.en: And you worked really hard to make the case that this legislation is good for your district.
sentences.zh: 你非常努力地证明这项立法对你的选区是有利的。

sentences.en: If we didn't pass the big, beautiful bill, it would have been a $1,600 tax increase to every Nebraska family.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不通过那个宏大、美好的法案，每个内布拉斯加州家庭的税收将增加1600美元。

sentences.en: That is a true middle-class tax cut.
sentences.zh: 那才是真正的中产阶级减税。

sentences.en: Next slide, please.
sentences.zh: 下一张幻灯片，请。

sentences.en: You look like a college professor on that stage talking about what's in this bill.
sentences.zh: 你在台上谈论法案内容时看起来就像一位大学教授。

sentences.en: People in here are upset with me that I voted to cut $2 trillion in spending from the budget.
sentences.zh: 这里的人对我投票削减预算中2万亿美元的支出感到不满。

sentences.en: But still.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此。

sentences.en: The Republican Party, now more than ever, represents the heart and soul of the working class.
sentences.zh: 共和党现在比以往任何时候都更能代表工薪阶层的心声。

sentences.en: You're booed.
sentences.zh: 你被嘘了。

sentences.en: How much does it cost for fascism?
sentences.zh: 法西斯主义要花多少钱？

sentences.en: How much do the taxpayers have to pay for a fascist country?
sentences.zh: 纳税人要为一个法西斯国家支付多少钱？

sentences.en: You're jeered.
sentences.zh: 你被嘲笑了。

sentences.en: Fascists don't hold town halls with open question and answer series.
sentences.zh: 法西斯分子不会举行公开问答的市政厅会议。

sentences.en: So I'm curious, as someone who sees so much value in this format, what was the value in that?
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，作为一个如此看重这种形式的人，那场会议的价值何在？

sentences.en: Was there any?
sentences.zh: 有任何价值吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, there's value because I think it's cathartic for the people that are so upset.
sentences.zh: 是的，有价值，因为我认为这对那些非常愤怒的人来说是一种宣泄。

sentences.en: And I get something out of it, you know?
sentences.zh: 而且我也从中有所收获，你知道吗？

sentences.en: People don't realize when you're standing on stage and everybody's looking at you, I see people that maybe are upset about the one big beautiful bill,
sentences.zh: 人们没有意识到，当你站在台上，每个人都在看着你时，我能看到那些可能对“宏大、美好法案”感到不满的人，

sentences.en: but they are with me on Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 但他们在乌克兰问题上是支持我的。

sentences.en: And I see that in the nonverbal.
sentences.zh: 我能从非语言表达中看出来。

sentences.en: I see people that are worried about the future of democracy, and they are smiling when I say fascists don't hold town halls.
sentences.zh: 我看到人们担心民主的未来，当我提到“法西斯分子不会举行市政厅会议”时，他们露出了微笑。

sentences.en: There's a communication back and forth that only the elected official gets to see when you're talking to a crowd of people that are upset.
sentences.zh: 当你面对一群愤怒的人群时，有一种只有民选官员才能看到的互动交流。

sentences.en: Had I not done a town hall in Lincoln, it would have been a slap in the face to my biggest city in my district.
sentences.zh: 如果我没在林肯市举行市政厅会议，那将是对我选区最大城市的一记耳光。

sentences.en: And before each town hall, I go out and shake the people's hands coming in, you know?
sentences.zh: 在每次市政厅会议之前，我都会出去和进场的人握手，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Chris Christie says it's hard to hate up close, right?
sentences.zh: 克里斯·克里斯蒂说，近距离接触就很难去恨一个人，对吧？

sentences.en: So I go up and I shake everybody's hands, and, you know, I get a lot of feedback.
sentences.zh: 所以我走过去和每个人握手，你知道，我得到了很多反馈。

sentences.en: But one of the things I heard a couple times when I was shaking people's hands was, thanks for realizing that we're in Nebraska, too.
sentences.zh: 但我握手时听到过几次的一句话是：谢谢你意识到我们也在内布拉斯加州。

sentences.en: And at first I was like, what are they talking about?
sentences.zh: 起初我心想，他们在说什么？

sentences.en: And it's easy to go to these rural communities where there's more, you know, Republicans.
sentences.zh: 去那些共和党人更多的农村社区很容易。

sentences.en: And as somebody who grew up in a small town, I felt that way before.
sentences.zh: 作为一个在小镇长大的人，我以前也有过这种感觉。

sentences.en: Like, am I really part of Nebraska?
sentences.zh: 就像，我真的是内布拉斯加州的一部分吗？

sentences.en: Isn't all this just about Oman Lincoln?
sentences.zh: 这一切不都是关于奥马哈和林肯吗？

sentences.en: And so to have people from Lincoln say, thanks for coming here and doing it here.
sentences.zh: 所以当林肯市的人说，谢谢你来这里举行会议。

sentences.en: We're in Nebraska, too.
sentences.zh: 我们也在内布拉斯加州。

sentences.en: This is your most Democratic corner of your district.
sentences.zh: 这是你选区中最民主的角落。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I thought, that's a compliment.
sentences.zh: 我想，那是一个赞美。

sentences.en: You know, like, I'm here, and we're doing this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像是，我在这里，我们正在做这件事。

sentences.en: Can I say that they were thanking you, but the hate, to quote Chris Christie, was up close.
sentences.zh: 我可以插一句吗？他们是在感谢你，但用克里斯·克里斯蒂的话说，那种恨意是“近距离”的。

sentences.en: It was not hard to hate up close in that room, it seeMs.
sentences.zh: 看来在那个房间里，近距离去恨并不难。

sentences.en: No, that's true.
sentences.zh: 不，那是真的。

sentences.en: But that was maybe 100 people of the 700 that were that upset.
sentences.zh: 但那700人里可能只有100人那么愤怒。

sentences.en: And at no time did I ever lose my cool or my mode of operation.
sentences.zh: 而且我从未在任何时候失去冷静或改变我的行事方式。

sentences.en: We just kind of went through it.
sentences.zh: 我们只是大致过了一遍。

sentences.en: And I did say going in, I said, hey, let people say their piece.
sentences.zh: 而且我确实在开始时说过，我说，嘿，让大家把话说完。

sentences.en: I do not want people drug out of here.
sentences.zh: 我不想让人被强行拖出这里。

sentences.en: That is not what this is about.
sentences.zh: 这不是我们要做的。

sentences.en: If that's the way they want to do it, that's the way they want to do it.
sentences.zh: 如果他们想那样做，那就随他们吧。

sentences.en: But if I'm not willing to go stand in the middle of my biggest city, how does anything ever get better?
sentences.zh: 但如果我不愿意站在我最大城市的中心，事情怎么可能好转呢？

sentences.en: Okay, next question.
sentences.zh: 好的，下一个问题。

sentences.en: Can you hear me?
sentences.zh: 你能听到我说话吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.en: I'm a lifetime member of the Veterans of Foreign Wars.
sentences.zh: 我是海外战争退伍军人协会的终身会员。

sentences.en: You know, I had somebody come up to me in Seward and say, you know, he's a 57-year-old postal worker.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在苏厄德，有人走过来跟我说，他是一位57岁的邮政工人。

sentences.en: You voted for a budget bill that cuts the Social Security supplement, which is a large portion of our benefits.
sentences.zh: 你投票支持了一项削减社会保障补助金的预算法案，这占了我们福利的很大一部分。

sentences.en: And these are benefits that we've earned.
sentences.zh: 这些是我们应得的福利。

sentences.en: We work for these benefits, okay?
sentences.zh: 我们为这些福利工作，明白吗？

sentences.en: We had made one change that he was fine with in his retirement system, but there was something else in the bill that wasn't good.
sentences.zh: 我们确实在他的退休制度中做了一项他可以接受的修改，但法案中还有其他不好的内容。

sentences.en: What I need to understand in your situation is the exact program that you're on and the exact impact that the bill in its current form is having.
sentences.zh: 我需要了解的是你所处的具体情况，你参加的是什么项目，以及该法案目前的形式会产生什么具体影响。

sentences.en: We're eligible to retire when we're 57, so we're not eligible for Social Security until we're 62.
sentences.zh: 我们57岁时有资格退休，但在62岁之前没有资格领取社会保障金。

sentences.en: So what the bill that you voted for does erases the 57 to 62 supplement that gets us to it, which is a large portion at that age of our retirement.
sentences.zh: 所以你投票支持的法案取消了57岁到62岁之间的补助，而这笔补助是我们退休后那段时期的重要收入来源。

sentences.en: Uh, I'm happy to sit down with you.
sentences.zh: 呃，我很乐意坐下来和你谈谈。

sentences.en: I'm happy to look at it.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意研究一下。

sentences.en: I will get the information, and then I will do my best to act on your behalf.
sentences.zh: 我会获取相关信息，然后尽我所能代表你们采取行动。

sentences.en: That is my pledge to you.
sentences.zh: 这是我对你们的承诺。

sentences.en: We went back, we called him, we made sure we understood it, and we were able to tell him, hey, that has been resolved.
sentences.zh: 我们回去后给他打了电话，确保我们理解了他的情况，并能够告诉他，嘿，问题已经解决了。

sentences.en: People don't see the casework that comes out of these things, but, you know, I would have never known about that issue with a postal worker that's 57 years old.
sentences.zh: 人们看不到这些事情背后的个案处理工作，但你知道，如果不是那位57岁的邮政工人，我永远不会知道那个问题。

sentences.en: There's no way I would ever have dreamt that.
sentences.zh: 我做梦也想不到。

sentences.en: But he came to a town hall, and he put it on everybody's radar.
sentences.zh: 但他参加了市政厅会议，并让所有人都关注到了这个问题。

sentences.en: But I guess I'm still wondering what it means for constituents, for voters, when these town halls go away.
sentences.zh: 但我还是想知道，当这些市政厅会议消失时，这对选民意味着什么。

sentences.en: If most of your party is avoiding this format, does something important get lost?
sentences.zh: 如果你们党内大多数人都在回避这种形式，是不是会丢失一些重要的东西？

sentences.en: Well, first,
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，

sentences.en: I will say the reason you see less of these is that you have constituents that attend on both sides of the aisle that say they're frustrated at their inability to have,
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，你之所以看到这类会议减少，是因为有来自两党的选民参加，他们表示对无法进行……

sentences.en: to glean information from a respectful back-and-forth dialogue because they're actually there to try and get answers to the questions that they have.
sentences.zh: 无法从尊重的双向对话中获取信息感到沮丧，因为他们实际上是去寻求他们所关心问题的答案的。

sentences.en: So a lot of the people that are doing the booing are the ones that are creating the challenge for others.
sentences.zh: 所以很多起哄的人，正是给其他人制造挑战的人。

sentences.en: But, you know, like, everybody does their job differently in Congress, and this fits my way that I do it.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，就像国会中每个人做工作的方式都不同一样，这符合我做事的方式。

sentences.en: Others are way more productive in different ways communicating with their constituents.
sentences.zh: 其他人以不同的方式与选民沟通，效率要高得多。

sentences.en: And some of my colleagues have legitimate safety issues that I don't feel like I have.
sentences.zh: 而且我的一些同事面临着我所没有的合法安全问题。

sentences.en: That is legit.
sentences.zh: 那是合情合理的。

sentences.en: In that moment when you hesitated about whether to cancel your own town hall, what do you think would have been lost if you had canceled all three of them this year, right?
sentences.zh: 在你犹豫是否要取消自己的市政厅会议的那一刻，你认为如果你今年取消了全部三场会议，会失去什么，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, how would that 57-year-old postal worker have gotten his concern across?
sentences.zh: 我是说，那位57岁的邮政工人该如何表达他的担忧呢？

sentences.en: Obviously, there's value.
sentences.zh: 显然，这是有价值的。

sentences.en: You know, like, I think a lot of people see it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为很多人都看到了这一点。

sentences.en: They don't think it has any value.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这没有任何价值。

sentences.en: And nobody's talking about the value that's there.
sentences.zh: 而且没有人谈论其中的价值。

sentences.en: You know, it's good for America that we have Republicans and Democrats that can spend an hour and a half in a room together.
sentences.zh: 你知道，共和党人和民主党人能在一个房间里共处一个半小时，这对美国是有好处的。

sentences.en: And, yeah, there's some shouting and yelling, but I got the chance to say what I wanted to say.
sentences.zh: 是的，会有一些大喊大叫，但我有机会说出我想说的话。

sentences.en: I got the chance to explain my votes.
sentences.zh: 我有机会解释我的投票。

sentences.en: I got the chance to essentially debate with a few of my constituents.
sentences.zh: 我有机会与我的几位选民进行实质性的辩论。

sentences.en: And they got the chance, in their eyes, to hold me accountable and to tell me how they felt.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，他们也有机会让我负责，并告诉我他们的感受。

sentences.en: We all got something out of it.
sentences.zh: 我们都从中获得了一些东西。

sentences.en: So, right or wrong, maybe there's a better way to do this.
sentences.zh: 所以，无论对错，也许有更好的方法来做这件事。

sentences.en: I've been going to these things for a long time, and I hope that, as Americans, they continue for a long, long time.
sentences.zh: 我参加这些活动已经很长时间了，我希望作为美国人，它们能长期持续下去。

sentences.en: But it sounds like you're going to keep holding town halls next year, as you have this year.
sentences.zh: 但听起来你明年还会像今年一样继续举行市政厅会议。

sentences.en: And I'm thinking back to the town halls you talked about when you were a young lawmaker.
sentences.zh: 我回想起你年轻时担任议员时谈到的那些市政厅会议。

sentences.en: And clearly there was emotion in them.
sentences.zh: 显然，那时会议中也有情绪。

sentences.en: But I don't think it looked like this.
sentences.zh: 但我不认为看起来像现在这样。

sentences.en: I mean, yes, when people were having their schools shut down, they were emotional and they were upset.
sentences.zh: 我是说，是的，当人们的学校被关闭时，他们很激动，也很生气。

sentences.en: Were they calling the lawmakers fascists?
sentences.zh: 但他们会称呼议员为法西斯吗？

sentences.en: I don't – I mean, I'm seeing you nod no.
sentences.zh: 我不——我是说，我看到你在摇头。

sentences.en: And what I'm really asking is you said in one of your town halls you urged voters to make the town hall,
sentences.zh: 我真正想问的是，你在其中一场市政厅会议上曾敦促选民让市政厅会议……

sentences.en: that you were about to embark on a model of discussion for the rest of the nation.
sentences.zh: 你说你即将为全国开启一种讨论模式。

sentences.en: So what do you think it says that your town halls went the way that they did about the nature of our democracy, the nature of our ability to have conversations right now?
sentences.zh: 那么，你认为你的市政厅会议以那种方式进行，说明了我们民主的本质，以及我们目前进行对话的能力的本质是什么？

sentences.en: What does it say to you?
sentences.zh: 这对你来说意味着什么？

sentences.en: Well, it's certainly strained, but it's also not representative of where I think most of the people are.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这当然很紧张，但这并不能代表我认为大多数人的想法。

sentences.en: I mean, the media grabs on to that person that's screaming fasciSt.
sentences.zh: 我是说，媒体抓住了那个尖叫着“法西斯”的人。

sentences.en: And it delights one half of America, and it repulses the other half of America.
sentences.zh: 这让美国的一半人感到高兴，却让另一半人感到反感。

sentences.en: But I have more in common with those screaming protesters than I do the rest of America that thinks that politics is a hobby doesn't affect them,
sentences.zh: 但我与那些尖叫的抗议者相比，比与美国其他认为政治只是与他们无关的爱好、根本不关注政治的人更有共同点。

sentences.en: and they don't pay any attention to it.
sentences.zh: 而且他们根本不关注这些。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Like, this is America.
sentences.zh: 这就是美国。

sentences.en: This is – every decision I make affects somebody.
sentences.zh: 这是——我做的每一个决定都会影响到某个人。

sentences.en: So you have kind of come to a grudging admiration for the passion that leads someone to come to a town hall like that and scream you're a fasciSt.
sentences.zh: 所以你对那种导致某人来到市政厅会议并尖叫“你是法西斯”的激情，产生了一种勉强的钦佩？

sentences.en: Of course, because they care, right?
sentences.zh: 当然，因为他们在乎，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: There are people that can live in America and take care of their family and not give one ounce of thought to anything that's happening in the world other than the bubble that they live in.
sentences.zh: 有些人生活在美国，照顾好自己的家庭，除了他们生活的那个泡沫之外，对世界上发生的任何事情都不屑一顾。

sentences.en: And the lady that's calling me a fascist is not living in that bubble.
sentences.zh: 而那位称我为法西斯的女士并没有生活在那个泡沫中。

sentences.en: She is very invested in her beliefs and where she thinks the country's going.
sentences.zh: 她非常投入于自己的信仰以及她认为国家的发展方向。

sentences.en: She showed up, and she's spicy.
sentences.zh: 她出现了，而且她很犀利。

sentences.en: Like, that's the town square.
sentences.zh: 这就是城镇广场。

sentences.en: That's politics.
sentences.zh: 这就是政治。

sentences.en: That's what we do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所做的。

sentences.en: That's like, if I think that my votes are the right votes, I should have no problem standing in the town square and defending them.
sentences.zh: 就像，如果我认为我的投票是正确的，我就应该毫无问题地站在城镇广场上为它们辩护。

sentences.en: And I did that.
sentences.zh: 我确实那样做了。

sentences.en: Well, Congressman, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，国会议员，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: My pleasure.
sentences.zh: 我的荣幸。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: By Sunday,
sentences.zh: 到周日时，

sentences.en: there was growing consensus that President Trump had broken from the principles of his European allies and sided with Russia during his summit on Friday with Vladimir Putin.
sentences.zh: 人们越来越一致地认为，特朗普总统在周五与弗拉基米尔·普京的峰会上背离了他的欧洲盟友的原则，转而站在了俄罗斯一边。

sentences.en: During the summit, Trump adopted Putin's view that to end the war between Russia and Ukraine, Ukraine must give up territory in a direct peace deal,
sentences.zh: 在峰会期间，特朗普采纳了普京的观点，即为了结束俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战争，乌克兰必须在直接和平协议中放弃领土，

sentences.en: including land unoccupied by Russia, rather than first trying for a ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 包括俄罗斯未占领的土地，而不是首先尝试停火。

sentences.en: That has alarmed European officials, who believe that the plan prioritizes Russia's goals over Ukraine's.
sentences.zh: 这引起了欧洲官员的警觉，他们认为该计划将俄罗斯的目标置于乌克兰的目标之上。

sentences.en: On Sunday, leaders from Germany, France, Britain, Italy,
sentences.zh: 周日，来自德国、法国、英国、意大利，

sentences.en: and Finland said that they would travel to Washington today to join Ukrainian leader Volodymyr Zelensky for a meeting with Trump.
sentences.zh: 和芬兰的领导人表示，他们将于今天前往华盛顿，与乌克兰领导人弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基一起会见特朗普。

sentences.en: Their goal, they said, is to present a unified front against Russia and to try to persuade Trump to back away from Putin's views.
sentences.zh: 他们说，他们的目标是建立统一战线对抗俄罗斯，并试图说服特朗普放弃普京的观点。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场痛苦、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。
